status.title: Status
status.name: Name
status.restart_module_warning: Are you sure you want to restart {name}? The service will be briefly unavailable during the restart.

settings.title: Settings
settings.receiver_emails_list: Enter an email address per line
settings.ban_local_network_tips: When enabled, CrowdSec can block IP addresses from private networks. Use with caution to avoid blocking trusted devices.
settings.bantime_tips: The 'Fixed' mode applies a ban with a constant duration, while the 'Incremental' mode extends the ban duration based on the number of failed attempts.
settings.static_bantime_increment_description: Use the same duration for every block
settings.dynamic_bantime_increment_description: Increase the duration for repeated detections from the same IP
settings.dynamic_bantime_duration_helper: Initial block duration in minutes. The duration increases for repeated detections from the same IP.
settings.invalid_bantime_duration: Enter an integer between 1 and 1440 minutes
settings.disable_online_api_tips: Connect this instance to CrowdSec Central API and share local detection signals with the community.
settings.enroll_instance_helper: Use an enroll key from CrowdSec Console to connect this instance
settings.helo_host_must_be_relevant_for_smtp: If notifications are marked as spam, set a custom sender domain. It will also be used for the HELO/EHLO command. Leave empty to use the node's FQDN.
settings.token_not_valid: The token provided is not valid
settings.whitelists_tips: Enter one IP address, CIDR range or fully qualified domain name per line
settings.smarthosts_is_needed_to_send_notificatio: To receive CrowdSec email notifications, configure the cluster email settings.
settings.group_threshold_tooltips: Email are sent each 24h or when the number of new alerts reaches this threshold
settings.pull_community_blocklist_tips: When enabled, CrowdSec can block IP addresses received from the community blocklist.

unban.title: Banned IP
unban.unban_tooltip: IP addresses that failed multiple login attempts are listed here. You can unban them if needed
unban.confirm_unban_ip_message: IP address {ip} will be unbanned. It may be banned again if CrowdSec detects new suspicious activity.
unban.confirm_delete_all_bans_message: All IP addresses banned by CrowdSec detections will be unbanned. Permanent bans and Threat Shield blocklists are kept. The addresses may be banned again if CrowdSec detects new suspicious activity.

detections.title: Detections
detections.no_alerts_description: CrowdSec has not detected any suspicious activity yet.
detections.page_description: Detections are suspicious activities found by CrowdSec, such as repeated login failures or known attack patterns. A detection does not always result in a banned IP.
detections.inspect_events_list_hint: CrowdSec stores only a sample of the events that triggered this alert, so this log can contain fewer entries than the total number of events detected.
detections.confirm_delete_message: All CrowdSec detection events and the bans they created will be permanently removed from the database. Banned addresses stay in the firewall until their ban expires. Threat Shield, community blocklist and local blocklist bans are applied again automatically; other manually added bans are lost. This action cannot be undone.

collections.title: Collections
collections.confirm_enable_message: CrowdSec will start detecting threats for {name}.
collections.confirm_disable_message: CrowdSec will stop detecting threats for {name}.
collections.hub_description: Collections add detection support for specific services, such as SSH, Nginx or WordPress. Enable only the collections that match services installed on this server. Visit the {hub} to see what each collection includes and detects.

capi.title: Threat Intelligence
capi.tooltip: CrowdSec Central API — connection status and CAPI blocklist lookup
capi.capi_disabled: Enable the Central API in Settings to use this feature.
capi.search_hint: Enter an IP address to see if it is included in the community blocklist
capi.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address
capi.ip_found: The IP address {ip} is listed in the community blocklist
capi.no_results_desc: This IP address is not currently listed in the community blocklist.

blocklists.title: Blocklists
blocklists.tooltip: Manage IP addresses blocked locally, blocked by the CrowdSec community, and IP addresses allowed to bypass blocking
blocklists.community_description: IP addresses shared by the CrowdSec community and received through the Central API.
blocklists.allowlist_description: Trusted IP addresses, CIDR ranges and domain names that should never be banned.
blocklists.allowlist_info_description: Entries in the local allowlist are never banned by CrowdSec. Use this list for trusted devices, networks or domains.

local_blocklist.description: IP addresses always banned by this server. Temporary bans set by CrowdSec are managed from the Activity page.
local_blocklist.entries_helper: Enter one IPv4 or IPv6 address per line. Networks are not supported.
local_blocklist.not_valid: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address instead of {value}
local_blocklist.ip_allowlisted: {value} is in an allowlist and cannot be banned

threat_shield.title: Threat Shield IP
threat_shield.blocklist_description: Threat Shield IP bans known malicious IP addresses using the blocklists enabled here. A higher confidence score means fewer false positives.
threat_shield.blocked_tooltip: Network packets from this list's addresses blocked by the firewall in the last 24 hours. An address on several lists is counted for the one with the highest confidence.
threat_shield.insights_tooltip: Built from attacks blocked across NethServer and NethSecurity installations. When enough servers report the same IP, it is added to this list and distributed to every server with Threat Shield add-on.
threat_shield.no_subscription_description: Nethesis and Yoroi blocklists require an active subscription that includes the Threat Shield add-on. Register this system to a subscription to enable them.
threat_shield.no_entitlement_description: This subscription does not include the Threat Shield add-on, so the Nethesis and Yoroi blocklists cannot be enabled. The system still shares its bans with Nethesis and receives the Nethesis global allowlist. Contact your provider to add the add-on.
threat_shield.search_hint: Check whether an address is banned by an enabled blocklist.
threat_shield.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address
threat_shield.ip_found: The IP address {ip} is listed in the {feeds} blocklist | The IP address {ip} is listed in the {feeds} blocklists
threat_shield.ip_not_found: This IP address is not currently listed in the blocklist.
threat_shield.allowlist_description: Threat Shield IP never bans the IP addresses and networks in the enabled allowlists. All allowlists refresh every 30 minutes.
threat_shield.nethesis_allowlist_tooltip: IP addresses of Nethesis services. Enabled automatically with a subscription, it can't be disabled.
threat_shield.name: Name
threat_shield.name_helper: 3 to 16 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter.
threat_shield.blocklist_format: Plain text file with one IP address per line. IPv4 and IPv6 addresses can be mixed. Networks and local addresses are skipped. If the file can't be downloaded, the last downloaded copy is used.
threat_shield.allowlist_format: Plain text file with one IP address or network per line. IPv4 and IPv6 entries can be mixed. If the file can't be downloaded, the last downloaded copy is used.
threat_shield.invalid_name: Enter 3 to 16 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter
threat_shield.duplicated_name: This name is already in use
threat_shield.reserved_name: Enter a name that doesn't start with nethesis, yoroi or crowdsec
threat_shield.unknown_feed: One of the selected blocklists does not exist anymore. Reload the page and try again.
threat_shield.nethesis_allowlist_tooltip_no_subscripti: IP addresses of Nethesis services. Available with a subscription.
threat_shield.blocklist_modal_description: Threat Shield IP bans the IP addresses in this feed.
threat_shield.allowlist_modal_description: Threat Shield IP never bans the IP addresses and networks in this feed.
threat_shield.blocklist_description_placeholder: e.g. Attackers reported by our SOC
threat_shield.url_credentials_description: Anyone with access to the system configuration or its backups can read the username and password in this URL.
threat_shield.duplicated_url: This URL is already used by another allowlist
threat_shield.delete_blocklist_confirm: The custom feed {name} will be deleted. Its IP addresses will no longer be banned.
threat_shield.delete_allowlist_confirm: The custom feed {name} will be deleted. Its IP addresses may be banned again.
